description: Verdict consistency eval — same trace, 20 question phrasings must yield the SAME bottleneck verdict and citation of the SAME raw fields. Pre-Issue #96 the skill flipped between GameThread-bound and GPU-bound depending on how the user phrased the question.

blind_protocol.rule: The judge MUST NOT see the scenario's expected_verdict or scenario.id when scoring. Same model may serve as writer and judge only if temperature=0.0 AND the judge sees ONLY {trace_response, candidate_answer}.

unit_violation.definition: Cited a number exceeding trace_duration_seconds*1000 (Layer 3 sanity check violation).

label_citation_missing.definition: Answer states a verdict without citing the source field name (e.g. claims 'GameThread bottleneck' without referencing summary.bottleneck_thread).

verdict_value_recomputed.definition: Answer's bottleneck time differs from verdict_value by more than f64 rounding (1e-6 ms). Skill recomputed instead of citing.

phrasing_drift.definition: Verdict thread name differs from the majority answer across the 20 scenarios (i.e. phrasing flipped the conclusion).

pass_threshold.notes: 20 of 20 phrasings must yield the SAME verdict. 19/20 allowed only when the 1 failure is a non-critical phrasing-drift; ANY critical-category failure (unit_violation / label_citation_missing / verdict_value_recomputed) blocks the eval regardless of count.

gold_fixture.description: 3 questions where the correct answer is independently verifiable by a human. The judge must score these BEFORE the 20 scenarios. Threshold: 3/3 correct → eval valid. 2/3 or fewer → judge drift, abort and replace judge model.
gold_fixture.drift_action: Abort eval. Replace judge model (e.g. switch claude-sonnet-4-6 → claude-opus-4-7) and re-run. Do NOT lower the threshold.
gold_fixture.category_coverage_rule: The 3 gold questions MUST cover the 3 critical categories 1:1:1 (unit_violation, label_citation_missing, verdict_value_recomputed). One gold question per critical category — drift detection is structural, not statistical.
